files.README.md:
# Hartsop Veterinary Practice - new clients

Clients register at the desk before their first appointment. The desk works from `checklist.txt`, which lists what a new client hands in, and separately what to bring to the first visit.
files.checklist.txt:
Hand in at registration
Registration form
Proof of address dated within three months
Signed consent for treatment
Payment mandate
Previous vaccination record
Microchip registration certificate
Pet insurance policy number
Bring to the first visit
Lead or carrier
Treats for the waiting room
Current medication in its original packaging
files.notes/desk-notes.md:
# Desk notes

Appointment reminders go out the evening before by text message.
The practice's own insurance is arranged by the group office.
